en.headline: Local trio Midnight Cowboy plays album live at West Kowloon tonight
en.dek: The indie band performs a full reading of its debut record See You Down The Road at The Box in Freespace, setting Hong Kong poet Yam Gong’s verse to rock.
body: Hong Kong indie trio Midnight Cowboy takes the stage at The Box in West Kowloon’s Freespace on Sunday evening for a live presentation of its debut album.

The 95-minute show forms part of the FreeWave music series and features the complete album See You Down The Road. The band, formed in 2024 by Olivier Cong, Benson Koo and Travis Leung, sets the poetry of Hong Kong writer Yam Gong to raw rock instrumentation and Cantonese spoken word.

Organisers said the performance channels themes of absurdity, unease and tenderness under the line “We love one another in the midst of disaster”. Tickets are available through the West Kowloon Cultural District’s usual channels.
The concert is one of several live music events scheduled across the city during the Mid-Autumn period.

zh.headline: 本地組合Midnight Cowboy今晚西九演譯首張專輯
zh.dek: 三人組合於自由空間盒子演出首張專輯《See You Down The Road》全曲，將香港詩人飲江詩句配以搖滾及粵語口白。
body: 香港獨立組合Midnight Cowboy周日晚於西九文化區自由空間盒子舉行現場演出，演譯首張專輯全曲。
約95分鐘的演出屬FreeWave音樂系列一部分，專輯名為《See You Down The Road》。組合由Olivier Cong、Benson Koo及Travis Leung於2024年組成，以搖滾編曲及粵語口白演繹香港詩人飲江的詩句。
主辦單位指演出圍繞荒誕、不安與溫柔等主題，以「我們在災難中彼此相愛」為引。門票可透過西九文化區常規渠道購得。
是次演唱會為中秋期間城中多場現場音樂活動之一。
